Helping students study & build careers in Europe! 

Hi, I am Dr Anannya Misra, a Veterinarian from India. I am currently pursuing my PhD in Belgium after completing my Master’s in Italy. Through this channel, I aspire to help students planning for higher studies and building a career in Europe. From Master’s courses, PhD opportunities to scholarships, internships, visa applications, and international student life, this channel will help you navigate your journey abroad with clarity.

Having studied across multiple European countries with full scholarships, I will also share practical advice, academic experiences, career pathways, and the realities of life as an international student and researcher in Europe. 

But that's not all! In this channel you’ll also find travel experiences, cultural explorations, and glimpses of my everyday life.

If you’re passionate about studying abroad, research,  or building an international career, subscribe and join the journey at Vet in Europe!
